title: NO FAINT WORDS IN THE STATION WINDOWS
why: His order of 2026-10-12 (#50), and today: take pictures and make sure the menus actually look good. The picture check of the new window frame found five places where words were too faint or too small to read: THE GAMBLE in the colour of a frame line, the contract tier tag at 12.5 pixels, the Fashion rack heads at 12 pixels and see-through, the locked Fashion tiles fading their name and what unlocks them along with the picture, and the stash hint line faded to half. All of them now read at full strength and at least 13 pixels; a locked tile still dims its picture. No word changed.
now: Words in the station windows are never faint: locked Fashion tiles dim only their picture, and every label is at least 13 pixels.
